summary: input() shows a prompt, waits for the user to type, and returns the text. Use it to get a name, a number, or any answer.
notes: input() always returns a str. type(raw_age) shows <class 'str'>.
int() converts the text to a whole number. Use float() for a decimal.
pitfall: Doing math on input() without int() causes TypeError: can only concatenate str (not "int") to str.
